text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have barely lifted these dumbbells at 
all, yet my body feels so very hot~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Turns out this slow training really 
suits me after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Doing it slowly while applying a light 
load. That's the core of this training, 
after all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I think you can lose weight 
in no time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My oh my~! Truly, we cannot thank dearest 
sister Ryan enough~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If not for you, Dear Sister, my tummy 
would have gotten much squishier.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, no, all I ever do is give them a 
little push from behind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sooner or later, I'm sure Bright could 
have done it on her own.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright is a truly hard worker, after all. 
Having watched her all this time, I can 
guarantee it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I'm really happy that you rely 
on me like this, though!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that inspires me to do my very best 
as well~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next let's do some 
call-and-response squats!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Nice, that's the spirit! You're in peak 
form~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as a result of her dedicated 
strength training, Mejiro Bright's diet 
ended in resounding success!
